control_title: Keep database engine patched against authentication bypass vulnerabilities
text: Database servers should run supported, patched versions of the database engine. Older MySQL/MariaDB versions have contained authentication bypass vulnerabilities that allow login without correct credentials under certain conditions. Apply vendor security patches promptly and avoid running end-of-life database versions in production.

control_title: Restrict database network exposure to application tiers only
text: Database services should not be reachable from general user networks or the internet. Bind the database to internal interfaces only and use firewall rules or security groups to restrict inbound connections to the specific application servers that require access.

control_title: Disable password authentication in favor of key-based SSH login
text: SSH should be configured to disable password authentication and require public-key authentication instead, reducing exposure to credential-stuffing and brute-force attacks. Combine this with disabling root login over SSH and restricting access to specific source networks where feasible.
